evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), 21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B).
Complete and accurate batch production and control records are necessary to ensure that manufacturing processes are consistently followed and reproducible.

affected_work.value: Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited Unit III의 무균 주사제 제조·공정 시뮬레이션·시험실 기록, 설비 세척 및 멸균 기록, 무균 충전·개입 관리, 일탈 조사와 데이터 무결성 및 CAPA 체계가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) inspected your drug manufacturing facility, Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (Unit III)
Your firm failed to establish and follow appropriate written procedures that are designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile

recommendation.value: FDA는 적절한 무균 작업과 클린룸 행동을 보장하는 계획, 생산 배치별 감독 및 무균 공정 중 품질보증 감독 빈도를 제출하라고 요구합니다. 또한 CAPA·데이터 무결성 조사와 시정 계획 등 서신에서 열거한 자료를 포함해 위반 시정 및 재발 방지 조치를 서면 제출하고, 규제 회의 일정을 수령 후 5일 이내 이메일로 요청하라고 합니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide your plan to ensure appropriate aseptic practices and cleanroom behavior during production. Include steps to better assure routine and effective supervisory oversight for all production batches. Also, describe the frequency of quality assurance oversight (e.g., audit) during aseptic processing and other operations.
